chapter: Teddy Wilson, Cafe Society and bebop
title: Joining Teddy Wilson's band with singer Jean Eldridge
summary: Back in October 1939 he joined Teddy Wilson, recording with vocalist Jean Eldridge, with Ben Webster, Al Casey and Harold Baker nearby.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, we'll get to that later. Right now, you came back in October of '39?
And that's when you joined Teddy Wilson.
And you recorded with Wilson in '39?
And with a vocalist name Jean Eldridge, right?
Jean Eldridge was a very fine girl. I think she would've been as big as Billie Holiday, if she had stuck with her profession. She was a great singer and she
just disappeared. I don't know what happened to Jean Eldridge after that band broke up.
And -- but in that band let's see who -- was Thelma Carpenter with that band or did she --
No, Thelma was with Coleman Hawkins band, at that time. But we were at the Golden Gate together, both bands.
Ben Webster, yes. Carl George, Harold Hal Baker --
